args: Per-account balance ledger with an explicit basis-point fee pot. Error-pure and overflow-checked. Conservation contract: held == UsersTotal + FeesAccrued + surplus.
Native-coin I/O for realms: the Receive receipt-guard trio (caller shape, envelope, denomination), Payout via RealmSend, reserve-protected Sweep, and HeldAt.

Deferred-action scheduling. Claim is consume-then-act over never-reused IDs, so at most one Claim per ID can succeed across all transactions. No closure or capability crosses a realm boundary. One on-chain consumer as of registration.

Named permissions granted to and revoked from addresses, O(log P + log H) membership. Each consumer allocates its own Book with its own Limits, so capacity contention across applications is structurally impossible. One on-chain consumer as of registration.
